questions.a: The point underground where the earthquake starts

questions.q: Which was stronger: Sichuan or Haiti?
Give one reason Haiti suffered so badly.
questions.a: Poor buildings, crowded capital, poverty, weak services

questions.q: Core: In the portal response box: 'Compare the effects of the Sichuan and Haiti earthquakes and explain why they differed.' Use data from the table.
questions.a: Comparison with data and at least three explained reasons

questions.q: Extend: Why are death toll figures for Haiti so uncertain?
questions.a: Destroyed records, mass burials, different counting methods

questions.q: Stretch: Is a natural hazard ever purely natural? Explain.
questions.a: The hazard is natural but the disaster depends on human vulnerability

questions.q: The point on the surface above the focus is the:
questions.a: B) Epicentre. The epicentre is directly above the focus, where shaking is usually strongest.

questions.q: Each step on the magnitude scale is about:
Big question: why different death tolls?
questions.a: Building quality, population near the epicentre, wealth and preparation
